subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Runtime container and per-frame objects shared across subsystems: singly/doubly linked-list containers with ownership-flagged node teardown, UI widget child-node destructors, menu action dispatch, bounded float arrays and clamped grid regions, AI driver state and performance governance, season-data lookups and championship scoring, plus audio sample dispatch and scene-name resolution.

summary: Proposes fourteen defensive classes for the generic runtime objects packet: a linked-list container family (eight list destructor/append/index methods sharing the four-dword head/tail/current/count bookkeeping), two node layouts (free-data flag at +0x8 and at +0xC) plus a UI-widget child-node destructor pair, a stored-pointer resolver, a menu action dispatcher, a bounded float array and a clamped grid region, an AI driver state object (state transition, penalty eligibility, performance target speed, random variation scaler), a season-data lookup group, a championship standings/scoring entry object, a scene-name resolver, an audio sample source, and a float-difference helper. Owner classes are proposals only; packet owners are UNKNOWN throughout.

function_roles.role: Audio sample dispatch: fetches a fallback position float when the sentinel -9.9999997e37 is passed, traverses the audio-entry linked list at this+0x0 with a position filter, and selects one of three playback paths from entry state fields at +36.
Returns the difference between a FloatGetter value on *this and a float at a 3900-byte offset whose base register was lost in decompilation; used by particle/weather and scoring-gate paths.
Menu UI action dispatch: stores action ids 0-8 into the menu data action slot at obj+0xF8C and delegates ids 9-13 to sorted-list/sprite/linked-list helpers; returns 1 on every path.
Reads the pointer at this+0x0, persists a copy at this+0x8, and returns the pointed-to DWORD, or 0 when the stored pointer is null.
UI widget child-node destructor: frees the payload at this+0x0 when the flag at this+0x8 is set and the pointer is non-null, then frees the node buffer when a2 bit 0 is set.

UI widget child-node destructor variant: teardown keyed on the flag at this+0xC, frees the secondary pointer at payload+0x4 then the primary block at this+0x0, and frees the node when a2 bit 0 is set.
Linked-list destructor: walks the head at this+0x0, frees flagged node data and every node, zeroes the four container fields, returns 0.
Linked-list destructor with per-node callback stub: frees flagged embedded data and the nodes, zeroes the container fields, returns 0.
Linked-list destructor (thiscall): frees node data when the node free-data flag at +0xC is set, frees every node, zeroes head/tail/current/count.
Linked-list append: allocates a 12-byte node, links it into the container at this+0x0 (seeding +0x4/+0x8 on an empty list), increments the count at +0xC.
List destructor for refcounted 884-byte-stride elements: per-element stub, frees the refcount block and data allocation, frees nodes, zeroes the container fields.
List destructor with two-level data free: frees the inner allocation at data[0] then the outer data block for flagged nodes, frees nodes, zeroes the container fields.
Bounds-checked float array lookup: rejects negative or over-capacity indices with a -1.0 return, otherwise returns the float at this+0x90 + 4*index.
Conditional AI state setter: notifies AIDriverStateTransition with the old/new pair via global dword_5EB978 and the driver state pointer at this+0x0, then writes this+0x2C.
Penalty-eligibility guard: requires server mode dword_7C569C==5, a permitting penalty state at this+0x30, and race phase dword_7C56A8 in {5,6,8}.
Grid region scan: computes clamped [0,7] row/col ranges from origin/scale fields at this+0x924..0x930 and calls the per-cell dispatcher 0x004BD900 for every cell.

AI performance target speed: scans the live vehicle array for the nearest leader and next car, selects the season-config fallback via off_5D2634/off_5D2630 when needed, writes the target to this+0x34C.
Random performance-variation scaler: two LCG draws via 0x005884ED scaled by a skill reference, with the session-type split at this+0x360==7 choosing +17604 over +17600.
Season audio parameter lookup: string-keyed list at off_5D263C, scalar reader 0x0058850F, plus a noise term from the flt_8AAE74 ring buffer.
Linked-list destructor with conditional release: frees the payload only when the node+8 flag is set, frees nodes, zeroes the container fields; structural twin of 0x00491DB0.
Indexed list accessor: guards the index against the count at this+0xC, walks the this+0x8 iterator a2 nodes, returns the first DWORD of the reached node's data.
Qualifying grid index lookup: finds the 'Qualifying' key in the season races section and linearly scans up to 104 entries comparing driver names, returning the 1-based slot.
Qualifying best-lap lookup by driver name: scans the Qualifying list, reads the entry value via 0x0058850F, rejects values below 10.0, returns -1.0 on failure.

Loads one career season standings entry from the token buffer: Name/VehFile/RcdFile strings, indexed FinishPosition/FinishPoints arrays at this+24 and this+216, summary fields this+408..428, active flag at this+0x1B0.
Season championship scoring: under GameState 5 reads the season position into this+0x1A8 and leader laps this+0x1A0; under 7 accumulates points into this+0x198 and writes per-slot results.
Resolves the current vehicle scene name pointer: reads the vehicle name at this+0x8 (default byte_5EA438), VehicleLookupByName, then the scene name at +124 of the current vehicle, or 0.

classes.name: RuntimeLinkedListContainer
classes.responsibility: Singly/doubly linked-list container: walk-and-free destructors (with and without per-node data release), append insertion, and indexed access, all over the four-dword head/tail/current/count bookkeeping block at this+0x0/+0x4/+0x8/+0xC.

classes.name: RuntimeLinkedListNode
classes.responsibility: List node with the free-data flag at +0x8: data pointer at +0x0, next link at +0x4, ownership flag at +0x8; also records the inner allocation and next-node-link reads used by the two-level and refcounted destructors.

classes.name: RuntimeLinkedListNodeWithLateFlag
classes.responsibility: List-node layout variant with the free-data flag at +0xC rather than +0x8, used by the late-flag destructor and the UI widget node teardown.

classes.name: UIWidgetChildNode
classes.responsibility: UI widget child node teardown pair called from DestroyUIWidgetHierarchy: frees the embedded payload (and its secondary pointer) when the ownership flag is set, and the node buffer only when the a2 low bit is set.

classes.name: StoredPointerResolver
classes.responsibility: Resolver that caches a stored pointer from this+0x0 into this+0x8 and dereferences the first DWORD of the pointed object, or 0 on null.

classes.name: MenuActionDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Menu UI action dispatcher: stores action ids 0-8 into the menu data action slot at obj+0xF8C and delegates ids 9-13 to sorted-list/sprite/linked-list helper routines.

classes.name: BoundedFloatArray
classes.responsibility: Bounds-checked float array: two capacity bounds at this+0x8 and this+0x88 and the element base at this+0x90; out-of-range index returns -1.0.

classes.name: GridRegion
classes.responsibility: Clamped rectangular grid region: row/column origin and scale floats at this+0x924..0x930, cell indices clamped to [0,7], per-cell callback dispatched for every cell.

classes.name: AIDriverState
classes.responsibility: Per-driver AI state object: conditional state transition with notification, penalty-eligibility guard, AI performance target-speed computation, and random variation scaling, over the driver state pointer at this+0x0.

classes.name: SeasonDataLookup
classes.responsibility: Free functions over the season data sections: audio parameter lookup, qualifying grid index lookup, and qualifying best-lap lookup, all resolving entries through string-keyed list search and the scalar reader.

classes.name: SeasonChampionshipData
classes.responsibility: Career championship season entry: token-buffer standings loading (indexed FinishPosition/FinishPoints arrays, summary fields, active flag) and per-race scoring (leader laps, finished position, season points total) against the season database.

classes.name: SceneNameResolver
classes.responsibility: Resolves the current vehicle's scene-name string: reads the vehicle name at this+0x8 (default byte_5EA438), looks the vehicle up by name, and returns the scene name pointer at +124 of the current vehicle.

classes.name: AudioSampleSource
classes.responsibility: Audio sample dispatch source: traverses the audio-entry linked list at this+0x0 by position filter and selects among passthrough/direct pitch-modulated playback paths from entry state fields.

classes.name: FloatQueryHelper
classes.responsibility: Float difference helper used by particle/weather and scoring-gate paths: FloatGetter on *this minus a 3900-byte-offset float whose base register was lost.

state_machines.name: AudioPlaybackPathSelection
transitions: any -> no_entry: traversal of the this+0x0 entry list returns null, dispatch returns 0
no_entry -> passthrough_146: FieldCompareConstant(node+36) true AND FloatComparisonCheck(node+36) false
no_entry -> direct_playback: FieldCompareConstant(node+36) true OR FloatComparisonCheck(node+36) false
no_entry -> passthrough_38: remaining entries fall through to the node+38 passthrough

state_machines.name: SeasonScoringPhase
transitions: any -> idle_scoring: GameState dword_7D00EC == 5 reads the season position into this+0x1A8 and increments leader laps this+0x1A0 when first
any -> post_race_scoring: GameState dword_7D00EC == 7 copies the position to a slot and accumulates points into this+0x198

state_machines.name: AIStateTransitionNotification
transitions: stable -> transitioning: incoming value differs from this+0x2C, AIDriverStateTransition notified via dword_5EB978 and write applied
transitioning -> stable: incoming value equals this+0x2C, no notification and no write

interfaces.name: MemoryAllocationInterface
interfaces.purpose: Allocation and release primitives for runtime nodes and payloads: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and FreeWrapper.

interfaces.name: SeasonDataAccessInterface
interfaces.purpose: Season data resolution primitives: locate the races section, string-keyed list search, null-checked slot fetch, and entry accessor.

interfaces.name: StringDataInterface
interfaces.purpose: String extraction, comparison, buffered copy, formatting and integer parsing used by season and menu paths.

interfaces.name: AudioChannelStateInterface
interfaces.purpose: Active-audio-channel check used to gate season scoring and season audio parameter lookup.

interfaces.name: AudioSamplePlaybackInterface
interfaces.purpose: Audio sample playback path helpers: entry state checks, passthrough wrapper, and pitch-modulated stereo playback.

interfaces.name: RandomVariationInterface
interfaces.purpose: LCG random draws and downstream registration of variation factors.

interfaces.name: FloatConversionInterface
interfaces.purpose: Float rounding primitive used by grid cell clamping and scoring distance thresholds.

interfaces.name: ListTraversalInterface
interfaces.purpose: Filtered traversal of the audio data linked list by position/distance.

compatibility_contracts.name: RuntimeLinkedListLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: List container bookkeeping block at this+0x0 (head), +0x4 (tail), +0x8 (current/iterator), +0xC (count); nodes hold data at +0x0, next link at +0x4, and a free-data flag at +0x8 (variant layouts place the flag at +0xC).

compatibility_contracts.name: ListTeardownOwnership
compatibility_contracts.description: List and node destructors release per-node payloads only when the node free-data flag is set, always free the node itself, zero the container bookkeeping after the walk, and free the node buffer itself only when the a2 low bit is set.

compatibility_contracts.name: AIDriverStateFieldLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-driver AI object: driver state at this+0x2C, penalty state at this+0x30, performance activation byte at +0x342, season speed reference +0x348, target speed +0x34C, session-type selector +0x360; transition notification goes through dword_5EB978 with the state pointer at this+0x0.

compatibility_contracts.name: PenaltyEligibilityGuard
compatibility_contracts.description: Penalty logic is gated on a server session (dword_7C569C == 5), a permitting penalty state at this+0x30, and a race phase dword_7C56A8 in {5,6,8}, with an optional penalty-enable plus session-type (dword_7C56A4 == 5) clause.

compatibility_contracts.name: SeasonDataSectionContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Season races section is located via SeasonRacesSectionFinder; string-keyed child sections (e.g. the 'Qualifying' key) are resolved by StringKeyedLinkedListSearch; entries are fetched by null-checked index (up to 104), name-compared via sub_588410, and scalar values read via sub_58850F.

compatibility_contracts.name: CareerStandingsEntryLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Season standings entry: indexed FinishPosition array at this+24 and FinishPoints at this+216 (raw-source only), summary fields at this+408..428, active flag at +0x1B0; runtime scoring uses season points total +0x198, leader laps +0x1A0, vehicle index +0x1A4, finished position +0x1A8.

compatibility_contracts.name: BoundedFloatArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Float lookup array with capacities at this+0x8 and this+0x88 and element base at this+0x90; negative or over-capacity indices return the -1.0 sentinel.

compatibility_contracts.name: AudioSampleDispatchContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Audio dispatch requires a traversal-filterable entry list at this+0x0 and treats the -9.9999997e37 position parameter as a request for the fallback current float from global flt_5ACD04; playback path selection depends on entry state fields not represented in the packet field table.

unresolved: Audio entry node fields at +36, +38 and +146 (base obj) and the playback-path selection semantics are not packet-confirmed; they are not present in the allowed field table.
FloatDifference reads a float at a 3900-byte offset from an uninitialized register-derived base; the source register is lost and the field cannot be located or named.
Menu action ids 0-13 and the semantics of the stored action slot at obj+0xF8C are not established; byte_4B9E1C is adjacent padding or unrelated data.
The consumer of the cached pointer written to this+0x8 by resolveStoredPointer is not evidenced; callers span collision, model-scene, and network-packet paths.
EmptyStub_0170 (callee 0x004B0170) is an empty stub; the per-node and per-element behavior it should perform is unknown.
The 884-byte element stride and refcount-block layout (count dword at data[-1]) in destroyListWithRefCountElements are inferred from addressing, not independently evidenced.
The two node layouts (free-data flag at +0x8 vs +0xC) are recorded as separate classes; the packet does not prove they are the same node type.
Common ownership of the four-dword list container block across the destructor/append/index functions is inferred from structural identity, not packet-proven.
The AIDriverState grouping of state transition, penalty eligibility, performance speed and variation scaling is a proposal; the packet does not prove a single owner object.
The grid cell dispatcher 0x004BD900 semantics (copy, mark, or notify) and the anchor at this + 576 are unknown; the origin/scale field roles are inferred from arithmetic.
Vehicle-source offsets +16540, +17600, +17604 and +13000 accessed through the dword_7C54F0 array are not packet field evidence; their identities remain unconfirmed.
The qualifying/race source split at this+0x360 == 7 is DERIVED from existing analysis, not packet-proven.
sub_58850F's return semantics (volume, pitch, time or score) are not established by the packet.
Season-database entry offsets +16480 (position), +16484 (status) and +16444 (distance) used by SeasonScoring are inferred from usage, not proven.
LoadCareerStandingsEntry's this+24 and this+216 indexed arrays and this+408..428 summary writes have no field evidence entries and are described from raw source only.
Twenty-one globals listed by the deterministic facts (flt_59E43C..flt_8AD3B4 set) appear nowhere in the raw decompiled sources and are unresolved (see unresolved_evidence_refs).
